intent: Finish the user-approved relaxation of industry-membership projection by treating CAP-0003-selected assertions with the same deterministic membership semantic signature as one corroborating source cluster. Preserve all equivalent supporting Evidence and the earliest source-known time instead of letting an arbitrary representative assertion delay historical visibility. Keep genuinely different semantic definitions on the existing auditable standard-to-deep model judgment path, and do not change CAP-0003 Reality, Evidence, valid-time or no-lookahead semantics.
rationale_summary: Package A removed the exactly-one-assertion gate but still materializes Evidence and known_at from only the model-selected representative assertion. When several selected assertions have an identical entity/industry/role/exposure/validity signature, that representation is deterministically equivalent and should preserve the whole corroborating cluster. Otherwise a later duplicate can incorrectly make a historically known membership appear later. The semantic-decision owner already belongs to CAP-0005; no new capability or truth owner is needed. The researcher orientation projection must also expose the upgraded multi-run audit provenance instead of assuming one semantic-decision mode.
